culprit_citations.quoted_text: Investment (1)(5) | Industry (2) | Interest Rate (3) | Reference Rate and Spread (3) | Maturity | Par (4) | Cost | Fair Value | Footnotes

findings.detail: The CAD marker is in the Par column, but the parser propagated it to cost_currency for valuation fields that are shown under Cost and Fair Value dollar columns.

rationale: FX03 is a real data error. The schedule header separates Par (4), Cost, and Fair Value; the cited rows place CAD immediately before the par amount, while Cost and Fair Value are the valuation columns with dollar presentation inherited from the table/section. The extracted observed value U_CAD for cost_currency therefore reflects the par currency being misattributed to cost, not a CAD-denominated cost field.
